GraphImport.title: Experimental import assistant
GraphImport.description: Bring a workbook or CSV files whose columns are properties of the ontology. Each sheet is read as a graph: a row is a resource, a column one of its properties. Nothing is written to the instance.
GraphImport.menuDescription: Read a workbook as a graph of the ontology. Nothing is written.

upload.drop: or drop a workbook (xlsx, xls) or a CSV file here

session.saved: This import is saved as it goes: you can leave it and resume it later.

layout.title: Rows of the sheet {sheet}
layout.help: Point at the row holding the column names, then at the first row of values. Rows between them, such as a row of units, are skipped. Row numbers are the spreadsheet's.

understand.help: For each sheet, the assistant suggests the class of its rows, the column identifying them and the property of each column, with its reasons. Expand a column to see why, accept or correct: your choices are saved and remembered for your next files.
understand.noCandidate: No property stands out: choose one or leave the column aside.
understand.otherPropertyPlaceholder: Search a property of the class
understand.leftOutNote: You left this column out: it gives no value and is not suggested again.

evidence.alias: You chose this property for "{header}" before.
evidence.label: The header is the label "{label}".
evidence.closeLabel: The header is close to the label "{label}".
evidence.sheetIdentifiers: {count} of {total} values are identifiers of the sheet {sheet}.
evidence.uniqueValues: Every row has its own value.
evidence.uniqueButIncomplete: No value repeats, but some rows have none.

note.duplicateSingle: Another column gives {property}, which holds one value only: choose one.
note.notATable: This sheet is not a table.
note.noExperiment: Choose an experiment to recognise its scientific objects.

literal.twoSeparators: "{value}" has both a comma and a dot: which one separates the decimals is unclear.
literal.ambiguousDate: "{value}" may be {dayFirst} or {monthFirst}: choose the order of the column.
literal.missingTime: "{value}" has a date but no time.
literal.missingZone: "{value}" has no time zone: choose the zone of the column.

graph.sheetLeftOut: The sheet {sheet} is left out until the class of its rows is chosen.
graph.sheetsLeftOut: {count} sheets are left out until the class of their rows is chosen: {sheets}.
graph.noIdentifier: The sheet {sheet} has no identifier column: each of its rows is a resource of its own, which no other sheet can complete.
graph.emptyIdentifiers: {count} rows of the sheet {sheet} have no identifier: each is a resource of its own.
graph.columnsLeftOut: Columns of the sheet {sheet} left out until their property is chosen: {headers}.
graph.propertyNotAccepted: The column {header} of the sheet {sheet} is left out: the class of its rows does not accept its property.
graph.unresolvedTypes: {count} rows of the sheet {sheet} have a type that names no known class: they take the class of the sheet.

problem.linkUnfound: "{value}" names nothing known: no row of the file, no instance you may see.
problem.linkAmbiguous: "{value}" names {count} existing instances: which one is meant is unclear.
problem.linkWrongClass: "{value}" is a row of the file of class {classes}, where {expected} is expected.
problem.classConflict: The sheets give this resource unrelated classes: {classes}.
problem.tooManyValues: {count} different values for {property}, which takes at most {max}.
problem.requiredMissing: {property} needs at least {min} value(s), the file gives {count}: required unless the resource already exists.

preview.ambiguousMatch: "{name}" names {count} existing resources of its class: which one the file completes is unclear.
preview.classMismatch: The existing resource {uri} is of class {classes}, where the file says {expected}.
preview.fileClasses: The sheets give this resource unrelated classes: {classes}.

creation.toFix: The file must be corrected for this resource first.
creation.completing: This resource exists already: completing it is not supported yet.
creation.conflict: This resource is in conflict with what the instance holds.
creation.targetFirst: "{name}" must be created first, at the step {step}.
creation.targetBlocked: "{name}" cannot be created, so neither can this.
creation.targetNotCreated: "{name}" is to be created and no step creates it.
creation.noExperiment: A factor belongs to an experiment: choose the experiment of the import, or give the factor one.
creation.existingFactor: The factor of this level exists already: adding a level to it is not supported yet.
creation.unreadable: The value {value} of {property} cannot be read.
creation.forbidden: You may not create these resources.
creation.pointedByBlocked: "{name}", created with it, cannot be created yet: it waits for it.
creation.noExperimentForObjects: Scientific objects are created in an experiment: choose the experiment of the import.
creation.tooMany: This step would create {count} resources; at most {most} are created at once. Split the file.
creation.sameName: Two resources of this step are named "{name}".
creation.noMoment: An event needs a date: its beginning or its end.
creation.noTarget: An event concerns at least one resource: give it one.
creation.noProvenance: Data need a provenance: choose the provenance of the import's data at the step Understand.
creation.batchRefused: The platform refused the batch {batch} of {batches}: {detail}

measure.targetUnfound: "{name}" is no scientific object of the file or of the experiment.
measure.noDate: This row gives no date: its values give no datum.
measure.variableUnfound: "{name}" names no variable you may see.
measure.duplicate: Another cell gives a value of the same variable, for the same target, at the same date.

check.title: Graph check
check.cut: {shown} of {total} problems listed; the figures count them all.

dates.title: Reading the dates
dates.zone: Zone of times written without one

preview.help: What the import would do to the instance, compared with what it holds within your rights. Nothing is written. Scientific objects are looked up only in the experiment chosen at the Understand step: without one, they all read as created.
preview.loading: Comparing the import with the instance…
preview.problems: The check of the graph finds {count} problem(s): the Understand step shows them column by column.

cell.NEW: The resource would gain this value.
cell.PRESENT: The resource holds this value already.
cell.CONFLICT: This value would replace one the resource holds.
cell.AMBIGUOUS: A row of the file and an existing resource share this name: which one is meant is unclear.
cell.ERROR: The file must be corrected here.
cell.TYPE: Gives the class of the row.
cell.IGNORED: Left out: the column's property is not chosen.

grid.legend: Blue: new value · grey: already there · red: conflict or to correct · orange: unclear link · italic: left out. Click a row to see its resource.

map.title: Map of the sheets
map.diagramFailed: The diagram cannot be drawn here: the list shows the same links.

node.missing: Required and given neither by the file nor by the instance: {properties}.
node.none: The file gives it no value.

understandGraph.canvasLabel: Graph of the sheets and their columns

legend.title: Legend
legend.sheet: Sheet; solid ring = class chosen, dashes = suggested, grey = to choose
legend.existing: Resources that already exist in the instance
legend.undecided: Column to decide: drag it onto a sheet or click it
legend.chosen: Link chosen by you or read in the file
legend.gestures: Click an element to see its details. Drag a column onto a sheet or onto existing resources to make it a link. Drag a sheet to move it, the background to pan, the wheel to zoom. Delete leaves the selected column out, Escape cancels.
legend.declared: Sheet the assistant added for what you declared

understandGraph.dragLink: Drag to link the column elsewhere
understandGraph.inspectorHelp: Click a sheet, a column or a link to see its details and change it.

pending.title: Link "{column}" to {target}
pending.help: Several properties can make this link: choose one. The best suggested comes first.

understandGraph.dropped: Link to {target} saved. This is where its cells land:
understandGraph.typeColumnHelp: This column gives the type of each row: it cannot be changed here.
understandGraph.bundleHelp: This sheet has many columns of values: they are grouped to keep the graph readable. Click a column below, or unfold them all.
understandGraph.classChangeWarning: Changing the class gives every column of the sheet back to the suggestions.
understandGraph.existingHelp: The cells of these columns name resources of this class that already exist in the instance.
understandGraph.sharedHelp: {count} identifiers are both in {from} and in {to}: they are the same resources, and their values add up. This link comes from the identifiers; it cannot be changed here.

missing.title: Required, no column
missing.help: The class of the sheet requires these properties and no column gives them. Give a value for all rows, or let another sheet give them.
missing.linkPlaceholder: Name or URI of what the property points to

declared.title: {class} · {name}
declared.help: Describe here what no file describes. Nothing is written to the instance: the resource will be created at the creation step, with the rest.
declared.nameRequired: The name is required: it is what the rows of the files point to.

creation.help: What the import would create in the instance, step by step, in the order they must run. "Check" runs the platform's checks without writing; "Create" writes all the ready resources of the step, or none. What was just created then reads as already there: running a step again creates nothing twice.
creation.disabled: Creation is off on this instance (graph-import.creationEnabled): the step only shows what it would create.
creation.loading: Working out what would be created…
creation.notAllowed: Your profile does not let you create these resources.
creation.unsupported: Not creatable by the assistant yet
creation.dataRefusedHelp: the cells refused are listed at the step Understand.

measure.title: Measures of the variable
measure.none: No variable yet: choose the one this column measures.
